title: State Space Model with Continuous Limit of HiPPO Matrix: Eigenvalue Analysis and Explicit Solution Formula
claim: A discretized quantity converges monotonically to its continuous limit as resolution grows, supporting the asymptotic analysis.
layout: Single line plot with markers, N on x-axis, zero reference line
description: A single matplotlib line plot titled 'Difference: τ1 − θ1' (the title is cut off on the right). The x-axis is N, from about 30 to beyond 150, with ticks at 50, 100 and 150. The y-axis is τ1 − θ1, from 0 to 0.0006. Blue circular markers joined by a blue line show a steep, convex decay. The curve starts near 0.00059 at N≈32 and falls to about 0.00026 at N=48. It then flattens toward 0 at larger N, reaching about 0.00003 near N=150. A horizontal blue line at y=0 marks the limit. Light gray grid lines cover the plot. The eye goes first to the steep drop at the top left. The figure has no legend and no highlighted 'ours' series.
caption: A plot of τ (N)
abstract: As a lightweight model for sequence processing, an LSSL that uses the HiPPO matrix has been proposed. In this paper, as the continuous limit of the HiPPO Matrix, we propose Continuized-HiPPO Operator. Furthermore, as examples of advantages obtained by using this operator, we show that one can analyze the asymptotic behavior of eigenvalues of a matrix related to the HiPPO matrix, and that the LSSL induced by the continuous limit Continuized-HiPPO Operator admits an explicit solution.
